title: Sudoku Creator and Solver
tagline: A Pygame Sudoku app that generates, plays, checks, and solves puzzles
summary: After building the Cryptogram Solver, I wanted to use backtracking on another kind of puzzle. This Pygame app can make Sudoku boards, let you play them, take a puzzle you type in yourself, and solve the board one step at a time. It works most of the time, which is honestly part of the charm.

overview.what: A Pygame app that makes Sudoku puzzles, lets you play them, checks your answers, and can solve any board one step at a time.
overview.why: After the Cryptogram Solver, I wanted to try backtracking on a different kind of puzzle.
overview.did: I wrote the puzzle generator, the play and hint modes, a way to type in your own puzzle, and a solver you can watch work.
overview.result: It works most of the time, which is honestly part of the charm.

hero.alt: Sudoku interface with a generated puzzle, options on the left and control toggles on the right
hero.caption: Playing a generated puzzle, with checking and the solver.

sections.heading: One program, several modes
body: It has hints, answer checking, erasing, typing in your own board, and a solver view. The puzzle keeps track of which cells are original clues, your guesses, hints, right answers, wrong answers or solver moves, so each one can be drawn differently.

sections.heading: Watching the solver work
body: Instead of solving the whole board instantly, the backtracking solver takes one step per frame. You can watch it try a number, hit a dead end, back up, and keep going until the grid is full.
